issues.description: The exercise and template expect assembleBookstore() to return a Bookstore, but the solution's assembleBookstore signature returns an array of Book ([Book]) while actually returning a Bookstore instance. This return-type mismatch will cause compilation errors and confuses the intended usage in Client.main().
issues.suggestedFix: Change the solution's assembleBookstore signature to return a Bookstore (private static func assembleBookstore() -> Bookstore) so it matches the problem description and the template usage in main(), or alternatively adjust main() to handle a [Book] if that was intended. Prefer returning Bookstore to preserve the exercise intent.
